verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official terminal CLI, Claude Code: you build with it in your terminal, and it has a dedicated screen reader mode. Community reports corroborate real hands-on use, including a month-long project and comparisons to Codex CLI. One user's report of an unresponsive terminal is a single anecdote set against other successful use, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on CLI installation, commands and scripted/non-interactive agentic workflows, plus broader independent corroboration of reliability.
